description: Fetch safe public research details for one active RoamWorthy model. Prefer model slug plus vehicle type from search_models; legacy UUID lookup remains accepted for compatibility but UUIDs are never returned. Returns canonical RoamWorthy URL, specifications, model description, live-stock count and public model-page source groups/review date when available. Source groups are not field-level verification. Set includeStock=true to receive up to five currently available exact canonical-model listing links; not a complete inventory.

includeStock.description: Return up to five available listings directly linked to this model; excludes unlinked and derivative stock.

name: get_model
title: Get RoamWorthy model research details
